description: What the live fleet shows now, as Shiptrail's Trends page reads it: the ports where most ships wait at anchor and for how long, the ports most ships are heading for, traffic through the straits and canals, ships stopped in the Southern Bight off Rotterdam and Antwerp, and a group of ships whose broadcast positions show in one false spot. Made about every 30 minutes.
